items.sentence: Being a powerful, free individual doesn't mean being able to choose between an infinite number of coffee flavors and styles, but being able to demand an economic system that respects, rather than exploits, workers and the environment.
items.prompt: mean의 목적어로 not A but B를 이루는 두 동명사구를 차례로 선택하세요.
answers: being able to choose between an infinite number of coffee flavors and styles
being able to demand an economic system that respects, rather than exploits, workers and the environment
items.explanation: being able to choose ...와 being able to demand ...가 not A but B 구조로 병렬 연결됩니다.

items.sentence: Being a powerful, free individual doesn't mean being able to choose between an infinite number of coffee flavors and styles, but being able to demand an economic system that respects, rather than exploits, workers and the environment.
items.prompt: respects, rather than ___, workers and the environment에 들어갈 동사를 고르세요.

items.sentence: When lack of information stops us from taking action, we feel as though we will be exposed or we may be fooled by liars, and we finally decide that it is safer to do nothing.
items.prompt: 문장 전체에서 and가 연결하는 두 주절을 차례로 선택하세요.
answers: we feel as though we will be exposed or we may be fooled by liars
we finally decide that it is safer to do nothing
items.explanation: or는 as though절 내부를 연결하고, 바깥의 and는 we feel ...와 we finally decide ... 두 주절을 연결합니다.

items.sentence: The populations of many bird species, tricked by the increasingly weird and unstable weather, are declining rapidly because habitats are being destroyed or undermined and food sources are disappearing.
items.prompt: because 뒤에서 and로 병렬 연결된 두 절을 차례로 선택하세요.
answers: habitats are being destroyed or undermined
items.explanation: because 이하에서 habitats ...와 food sources ... 두 절이 and로 연결되고, 첫 절 내부에서는 destroyed or undermined가 다시 병렬입니다.
